bsb_text: He is the son of a woman from the daughters of Dan, and his father is a man of Tyre. bsb_text: Then Jehu looked for Ahaziah, and Jehu’s soldiers captured him while he was hiding in Samaria. So Ahaziah was brought to Jehu and put to death.
